title: CANLINK: Evaluation of the Intralink Intradiscal Device for Low Back Pain Due to Degenerative Disc Disease
official: CANLINK: A Prospective Clinical Study Evaluating the Safety and Performance of the Intralink Intradiscal Device for Treatment of Low Back Pain From Degenerative Disc Disease
summary: A single site, prospective study to evaluate the safety and performance of the Intralink device in participants with chronic or recurrent non-radicular discogenic low back pain (LBP) due to degenerative disc disease (DDD).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 22 - 80 years
* Degenerative Disc Disease (DDD)
* Six (6) months or more of chronic low back pain and failure to respond to conservative care
* Pain medication use has been stable for at least 30 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body Mass Index (BMI) \>40 kg/m2
* Uncontrolled diabetes
* Symptomatic DDD at more than 2 levels
* Previously diagnosed Paget's disease, osteomalacia, other metabolic bone disease
* Target disc collapse (disc height loss)
* Active systemic or spine infection
* Recent (\< 3 months) therapeutic interventions (i.e., IDET, PRP or stem cell injections) on the target disc(s)
* Any surgery at the index level (i.e. discectomy or intradiscal ablation) or any extensive surgery (fusion, artificial disc, laminectomy) at any lumbar level
* Previous treatment of target disc level with steroid injection, intradiscal injection, trigger point injection, facet or medial branch block within 90 days of enrollment
* Active malignancy
* Spinal tumor
* Presence of extruded disc herniation or wide annular fissures confluent with large disc protrusions at the symptomatic level.
* Symptomatic spinal stenosis (i.e., neurogenic claudication)
* Congenital or degenerative spondylolisthesis greater than grade 1
* Currently participating in another investigational study that could interfere with the outcome measures of this study
* Known anaphylactic reaction to contrast dye
* Opioid medication \>60 MME/day within 60 days of enrollment
* If female, participants who are pregnant or are trying to become pregnant during the course of the trial (due to risks of additional radiation exposures); participants of child-bearing potential that are sexually active must use a reliable form of birth control and present a negative urine pregnancy test prior to the implant procedure
* Other protocol defined inclusion/exclusion may apply
